extDescription.message: Chrome Extension Starter, using TypeScript, Preact, TailwindCSS, Vitest and RSBuild.

optionsDescription.message: Configure the extension using TailGrids-first form controls.
optionsDescription.description: Description shown at the top of the options page

likesColorDescription.message: Use the selected color when applying changes.
likesColorDescription.description: Helper text for the color preference toggle

backgroundChanged.description: Message shown when background color changes

transportDescription.message: Pair two Chrome profiles with a five-character code, then confirm both browsers.

transportStatusDescription.message: State of the extension-only WebRTC transport.

requestNoController.message: Application controllers are not yet implemented. Phase 4 leaves applicationKey="unspecified" in REQUEST_NOT_SUPPORTED until Phase 6/7/8 ships a supported contract.

roleDescription.message: Stored in chrome.storage.local. Never syncs across machines.

pairingDescription.message: Generate a five-character code on the host. Type it once on the other Chrome profile, then confirm both browsers. The pairing service is trusted only for this first introduction.

pairingPageHelp.message: Choose this profile’s role, pair the other browser with a five-character code, then confirm both sides. Slack sharing stays optional.

pairingCodeHelp.message: Type the five-character code. Letters are capitalized automatically.

pairingRoleLocked.message: Role is locked while a pair is remembered. Forget the pair to change it.

pairingChooseRole.message: Choose this profile’s role before generating or entering a code.

slackHostHelp.message: Enable sharing on this browser, sign into Slack normally if needed, then refresh sources. The client starts the transfer. Microsoft 365 and Zoom are not supported.

slackClientHelp.message: Enable sharing on this browser too. This profile must not already be signed into Slack — existing sessions are not overwritten. Connect to the host, choose the workspace, then start. Microsoft 365 and Zoom are not supported.

slackRoleHelp.message: Set this profile’s role before transferring Slack. Microsoft 365 and Zoom are not supported.

slackConsent.message: I authorize transfer of the shared Slack session between my host and this browser. These credentials may grant access beyond the selected workspace, including its Enterprise Grid identity.

slackNeedConnection.message: Connect this profile to the host before listing sources or starting a transfer.

slackHostEmpty.message: No ready Slack session on this browser. Open Slack, sign in normally, then refresh sources. There is no automatic sign-in.

slackClientEmpty.message: The host has no ready Slack session. On the host, open Slack, sign in normally, then refresh sources here.

slackChooseClient.message: Select the intended workspace and account. Selection is required before starting.

slackChooseHost.message: These workspaces are available for the client to request. Start the transfer from the client.
